sources.citation: Lewis et al., Neuron 2020;108(4):659–675.e6, DOI 10.1016/j.neuron.2020.10.002. Parallel social information processing circuits are differentially impacted in autism; GSE147092; Goff Lab source matrix.
sources.notes: These are the authors' Monocle2 CENSUS estimates of mRNA copies per cell, imported without renormalization or rounding; they are not raw read counts, UMI counts, CPM, or TPM. The 146 profiles are individual cells, not 146 independent animals. Source animal/pool labels M3, M4 and M1-5, plates and Fluorogold labeling are retained for each cell. All retained cells are annotated P25 in the authors' cellular annotation; GEO sample records describe P23. This discrepancy is retained rather than resolved by inference. The paper describes male mice, while per-cell annotation lacks sex. Feeding state is unreported. No group is eligible for the reference-only filter. Source final CellType labels are preserved. They may differ from the provisional Cell_Type_guess and the Fluorogold labeling; those source fields are retained separately. This expression-only reference supplies no differential-expression comparison, significance test, or cross-study mean.
